topIndia.title: NSDC launches nationwide cloud, AI skilling initiative
topIndia.summary: NSDC has launched a nationwide cloud and AI skilling initiative to train 1.5 lakh learners, including 10,000 participants through AWS re/Start. The programme aims to expand access to job-ready tech skills, particularly for youth in Tier II and Tier III cities.
